user.title: Add a phone
user.description: Internal works at home and never leaves your network. External works away from home and needs Home Assistant to be reachable from outside. Home Assistant Cloud needs no port forwarding.

create_entry.default:
{qr}

Scan this with your phone's camera, or with the camera button in the app. Or paste by hand:

URL:
`{webhook_url}`

HMAC signing secret:
`{secret}`

Open the app, go to the Health tab, Webhook card, and paste both. Do the same on the Screen Time tab, then tap Test and Sync now. Sensors appear as soon as the first data arrives.

If the phone cannot reach that URL, set your address under Settings > System > Network and open this integration's Reconfigure to get the corrected URL and a new code.
